nodes.label: Framer Marketing Design System
nodes.rationale: A dark-canvas marketing system based on Framer visual analysis.

nodes.label: Dark Canvas
nodes.rationale: Near-black canvas is the default surface and visual whitespace.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Display and body typography define hierarchy and the brand voice.

nodes.label: GT Walsheim Medium
nodes.rationale: Display typeface used for assertive, tightly tracked headlines.

nodes.label: Inter Variable
nodes.rationale: Body typeface, with OpenType variants used to create a bespoke voice.

nodes.label: Sky Blue Accent
nodes.rationale: Reserved for hyperlinks, focus rings, and selection indicators rather than surfaces.

nodes.label: Gradient Spotlight Cards
nodes.rationale: Violet, magenta, orange, and coral cards provide scarce atmospheric contrast inside monochrome grids.

nodes.label: Primary CTA Pill
nodes.rationale: White, 100px-radius CTA is the primary action vocabulary.

nodes.label: Surface Lift Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Canvas, surface-1, and surface-2 communicate hierarchy on dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: Responsive Behavior
nodes.rationale: Breakpoints define navigation collapse, grid collapse, comparison treatment, and display scaling.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: Requires consulting the installed Next.js documentation before code changes because this version may have breaking changes.

nodes.label: Development Server
nodes.rationale: The documented local command is npm run dev, with yarn, pnpm, and bun alternatives.

nodes.label: next/font Geist Integration
nodes.rationale: The README says next/font optimizes and loads the Geist font family.
